name: Finnish Quantum Technology Strategy
description: The Finnish Quantum Technology Strategy is a national initiative coordinated by Business Finland and InstituteQ to establish Finland as a leader in quantum technologies. The program funds quantum computing research, quantum communication infrastructure, and industry partnerships. It brings together Finnish universities, research institutions, and companies to accelerate quantum technology development.

VTT and CSIRO Explore Collaboration via 'Quantum Leap' Project — Quantum Computing Report

news.title: Finland and Australia Explore Quantum Technology Collaboration via VTT 'Quantum Leap' Project
news.excerpt: A VTT delegation attended the Quantum Australia Conference in April 2026 to discuss collaboration with CSIRO under VTT's Quantum Leap project, covering quantum software, error correction, and energy-efficient quantum components. Finnish partners include IQM, SemiQon, Neste, Vexlum, and Quanscient, alongside VTT's 50-qubit superconducting quantum computer.
